title: Prices, staff and roles
summary: Keep the price list, invite your team, and set what each role can do.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.narration: As the clinic owner, you set up the clinic in Settings. Tap it in the menu.

steps.title: The sections
steps.narration: Each section is on the left. Changes here apply to everyone in the clinic.

steps.title: Price list
steps.narration: Open Price list. These are the services and fees that appear on bills.

steps.title: Add a service
steps.narration: To add a service, tap Add entry.

steps.title: Name it
steps.narration: Type the name of the service, the way you want it on the bill.

steps.title: Set the price
steps.narration: Type the price in rupees. Turn on GST applies if tax is charged on it.

steps.title: Save
steps.narration: Tap Save. The service is now on your list, and ready to use on bills.

steps.title: Team and roles
steps.narration: Next, open Team and roles to see who works in your clinic.

steps.title: Invite someone
steps.narration: To add a person, tap Invite. You choose their role, and they get a link to join.

steps.title: Choose a role
steps.narration: Pick a role, such as doctor or front desk. The role decides what they can see and do.

steps.title: What each role can do
steps.narration: Below the team is a table of roles and areas. Tap a cell to switch an area on or off for everyone with that role. It saves at once. The owner always has full access.
